newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products trade flat in thin market.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products trade flat in thin market.

text.p: NWE oil products were flat in lacklustre trade on Wednesday.
Gasoline drifted at lower levels with most buying interest centred on May delivery material. May Eurograde barges traded at $197 at least four times early on.
Naphtha was steady with May swaps talked around the $181.$181.50 level and cargoes bid a dollar below there.
Gas oil was steady with unchanged futures and premiums. Activity was slow, as the market awaited NYMEX.
High sulphur barges lost $2 in very quiet trade, with only one deal seen done, at $83 fob.
Cargoes were quiet again, with Portugal's fuel oil tender attracting interest.
